subject.title: fix(browser): stop screenshot vision-failure fallback from injecting raw base64

question: Should a configured browser image-understanding failure permanently produce a text-only screenshot result, even when the primary model may otherwise be able to inspect the raw screenshot?
rationale: The patch fixes the proven session-state contamination, but it also deliberately changes the fallback semantics for an existing configured setup; tests can validate either behavior but cannot select the desired compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve text-only recovery
options.body: Accept the proposed contract: configured vision errors return a text failure and explicit outbound-share hint, never a model-context image block.

options.title: Preserve image availability safely
options.body: Keep an image-capable recovery for configured vision failures, but design it so raw base64 cannot persist in session tool-result history.

options.title: Pause for owner design
options.body: Defer this PR until browser and agent-runtime owners specify the intended behavior for transient configured-vision failures.

recommendation.title: Approve text-only recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed contract: configured vision errors return a text failure and explicit outbound-share hint, never a model-context image block.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the implementation and can incorporate the selected contract, while a current-main historical owner could not be verified from the available review evidence.
